scenario: perf-race-entry (CI), bahrain, 1440x900, menu START RACE (full intro); one baseline per software-GL lane (APEX_GL; unset = swiftshader)
note: Baseline = max of the observed runs; the ratio applies to all three numbers. A lane with a null baseline only records. CI load swings software-GL block times up to ~75% run to run, so this catches large regressions only. The long-task ring holds 64, so a count at 64 is saturated.
